```python
import re
from pathlib import Path

# Input file: one listing per line (title + description)
# Example line:
# "Selling AR parts - discreet shipping worldwide"
INPUT = "listings.txt"

# A minimal set of keywords for triage (expand with legal/compliance guidance)
KEYWORDS = [
    r"\bAK-?47\b",
    r"\bAR-?15\b",
    r"\bhandgun\b",
    r"\brifle\b",
    r"\bammo\b|\bammunition\b",
    r"\bsilencer\b|\bsuppressor\b",
    r"\bgrenade\b",
    r"\bblack market\b",
    r"\bno paperwork\b",
    r"\bdiscreet shipping\b",
]

pattern = re.compile("|".join(KEYWORDS), re.IGNORECASE)

def flag_listings(text_lines):
    flagged = []
    for idx, line in enumerate(text_lines, start=1):
        if pattern.search(line):
            flagged.append((idx, line.strip()))
    return flagged

def main():
    lines = Path(INPUT).read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
    flagged = flag_listings(lines)

    print(f"Scanned {len(lines)} listings.")
    print(f"Flagged {len(flagged)} listings for human review:\n")

    for idx, line in flagged:

if __name__ == "__main__":

```
